name: corner_probe_400ms
description: RISKY-CORNER PROBE, run BEFORE committing to the full 30 s grid. The four cells with no (or n=1) coverage: 750/850/950 x 400 ms have ZERO clean cycles ever recorded, and 950x300 has exactly one. Ordered by ENERGY ASCENDING (0.97 -> 1.16 -> 1.24 -> 1.55 J at R~4.3 ohm) so the ceiling is met gradually instead of jumping straight to the worst cell. 3 cycles + 1 bootstrap each is enough to see whether the load cell clips (5.000 V) or the laser rails (0 V), which is the only question being asked here - level means are not the goal. Same 30 s cool as the full grid, so whatever survives transfers directly into it. ~10 min. Run with --abort-on-bad-sense; do NOT use --stop-on-fail, we want all four data points including the ones that clip.
